none: PAS NLM-6BA63D: Roman Coin: Radiate of Postumus
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP C [---]VS AVG ; R/ HERC PA[CIFERO]

Copper alloy coin. Radiate, possibly of Postumus (260-269), possibly Cunetio no. 2395.2. Obverse description: Radiate bust, bearded and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IMP C [---]VS AVG. Reverse description: Nude male figure standing left holding branch in right hand and with cloak or skin over his left arm; possibly Hercules. Reverse inscription: HERC PA[CIFERO]. Diameter: 21.7mm, Weight: 2.88gms, die axis: 6
